architecture.topology: 16x16 mm octilinear (135-deg obtuse-bend / 45-deg diagonal) rotated d=3 surface code (Surface-17: 17 circular qubits, 24 CPW-linked floating couplers) + 10x10 mm extracted 2Q+1TC EM unit cell
architecture.qubits: Circular wide-gap fixed-frequency ScalablePadQubit: 280 um island, 46 um pocket gap, keyhole readout (pad r 13 um, gap 20 um), vertical Manhattan JJ at a free diagonal corner (180 deg pattern on N corners)
architecture.coupler: FloatingTunableCoupler hub_style rect: C-arcs (26 um gap, 24 um wide, 28 deg), 10/6 um necks, rounded-rect hub 230x180 um, A-B gap 6 um, rail SQUID 60x20 um (JJs at 0/90/180/270 deg), straight T flux line
architecture.readout: 4 diagonal (45-deg) continuous layer-1 shared-bus lambda/2 Purcell filters immediately outside the Surface-17 diamond (u_purcell=5.60 mm in r8) + 17 exact-length lambda/4 DRC-B7 meandered readout resonators (4.24-4.36 mm total, 6.85-7.17 GHz, ZERO resonator/Purcell airbridges); 2 PurcellReadout channels (7.05 / 6.85 GHz) on unit_cell
architecture.control_routing: 41 control lines routed by the clearance-aware octilinear A* router (code/general/octilinear_router.py, skill/airbridge.md 4a): >=180 um centerline clearance, 90-deg crossings only
architecture.junction_direction: Manhattan-compliant: fingers along x/y; orientations 0/90/180/270 deg (user-approved, no extra coupons)
